summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, announcing withdrawal of its offer to acquire all outstanding Genco Shipping shares. Diana's offer was $24.80 cash (adjusted for a $0.80 dividend) plus one Diana share valued at $2.54, implying about $27.34 total. Genco demanded $27.50 cash, $2.00 dividends, and three Diana shares, valuing approximately $36.91 per share — a 57% premium to Genco's undisturbed price. Diana withdrew citing unreasonable demands, remains Genco's largest shareholder, and will continue to press accountability. Watch for potential activist escalation or revised bid.
